_note: Target ranges are starting points from fitter systems / literature, not validated standards. Edit freely. low or high may be null (one-sided). confidence: literature | rule_of_thumb | tracked_only. role: fix (drives advice) | hint (shown as a note only) | tracked (no judgement).

_sources.knee_flexion_bdc: Dynamic 2D at BDC ~8° above static Holmes 25-35°; suggested 33-43° (Acta Bioeng Biomech 2019). Retül ~35-40°.
_sources.hip_closed_tdc: Closed hip angle at top of stroke >=40°, 45° preferred (Working Triathlete 2023; BikeFittr 35-45°). Measured along the femur (shoulder-hip-knee): the article says pedal, but shoulder-hip-pedal at TDC is ~100°, so 40-45° only fits the femur line.
_sources.torso_angle: Velogic: elite 10-15°, general 20-30°; BikeFittr 20-35°, <20° linked to neck/shoulder pain.
_sources.shoulder_angle: Velogic tri metrics: shoulder angle avg 75-100°.
_sources.forearm_angle: Velogic forearm 0-20° (start 5-10°); high-hands trend 5-25° extension tilt.
_sources.upper_arm_angle: Upper arm vertical to 10-20° forward (fitter guides).
_sources.knee_elbow_gap_mm: No published range; only a clearance check.
